stories.title: Anthropic reportedly plans to move forward with IPO plans
stories.summary: The AI company is expected to set its valuation range this week, the Wall Street Journal reported.

stories.zh_summary: 根據《華爾街日報》報道，這家人工智慧公司預計將在本週確定估值範圍。

stories.title: The stock-market rally keeps spreading beyond Big Tech. October inflation data could put it to the test.

stories.zh_title: 股市的上漲持續蔓延到大型科技公司之外。十月份的通膨數據可能會對其進行考驗。
stories.zh_summary: 週二的消費者物價指數通膨報告和聯準會發言人的陣容可能會考驗輪換交易的彈性

stories.title: AI hardware startup Nominal triples valuation to $3B in 8 months
stories.summary: Nominal, a startup that offers an AI platform for hardware engineering and claims Anduril as a major customer, has raised another big round of financing that triples its valuation.
stories.zh_title: AI 硬體新創公司 Nominal 估值在 8 個月內成長兩倍至 3B 美元
stories.zh_summary: Nominal 是一家為硬體工程提供人工智慧平台的新創公司，並聲稱 Anduril 是其主要客戶，該公司已籌集了另一輪大筆融資，使其估值增加了兩倍。

stories.title: Meta releases Muse Ember, a new lightweight model for agent execution
stories.summary: At 10 cents per million input tokens, Ember is significantly cheaper than frontier competitors like Haiku and Luna.
stories.zh_title: Meta 發布 Muse Ember，一種新的輕量級代理執行模型
stories.zh_summary: Ember 每百萬輸入代幣 10 美分，比 Haiku 和 Luna 等前沿競爭對手便宜得多。

stories.title: Jensen Huang’s Troubles Leave the AI Industry Reeling
stories.summary: With a big checkbook and sought-after chips, Nvidia’s CEO had his thumb on the world of AI. An extramarital affair with a suspected Chinese spy may put all of that at risk.
stories.zh_title: 黃仁勳的麻煩讓人工智慧產業陷入困境
stories.zh_summary: 英偉達執行長擁有巨額支票簿和廣受歡迎的晶片，他對人工智慧世界充滿了興趣。與疑似中國間諜的婚外情可能會讓這一切都面臨風險。

stories.title: What could China get from Jensen Huang?
stories.summary: It's difficult to overstate Nvidia's power in today's AI landscape. The company's chips are the bedrock upon which advanced AI technology in the US is being built, and demand has consistently outpaced supply for years. Nvidia has also been an influential investor in a wide range of up-and-coming AI companies in recent years, with about […]
stories.zh_title: 中國能從黃仁勳那裡得到什麼？
stories.zh_summary: 無論如何強調 Nvidia 在當今人工智慧領域的實力都不為過。該公司的晶片是美國先進人工智慧技術的基石，多年來需求一直超過供應。英偉達也是許多新興人工智慧領域頗具影響力的投資者

stories.title: Jim Cramer says Anthropic's IPO could make or break the AI trade. Here's why
stories.summary: Anthropic's initial public offering could be a crucial test of investor confidence in the AI trade, CNBC's Jim Cramer said.
stories.zh_title: Jim Cramer 表示 Anthropic 的 IPO 可能決定人工智慧產業的成敗。這就是為什麼
stories.zh_summary: CNBC 的 Jim Cramer 表示，Anthropic 的首次公開發行可能是對投資者對人工智慧產業信心的關鍵考驗。

stories.title: As Nvidia’s stock falls, here’s what Wall Street has to say about the Jensen Huang scandal
stories.summary: The fallout from the board’s new investigation could become “a longer-lasting problem for the company,” analysts say.
stories.zh_title: 隨著英偉達股價下跌，華爾街對黃仁勳醜聞的評價如下
stories.zh_summary: 分析師表示，董事會新調查的影響可能會成為「公司面臨的一個更持久的問題」。

stories.title: Are AMD and Broadcom the real winners of the Nvidia spy scandal?
stories.summary: The chip makers’ shares were posting big gains Monday — but those companies could also be subject to greater scrutiny over their sales practices, analysts say.
stories.zh_title: AMD 和博通是 Nvidia 間諜醜聞的真正贏家嗎？
stories.zh_summary: 分析師表示，晶片製造商的股價週一大幅上漲，但這些公司的銷售行為也可能受到更嚴格的審查。

stories.title: Jensen Huang pulls out of ElevenLabs Summit amid Nvidia controversy
stories.summary: The Nvidia CEO also pulled out of an Anthropic event earlier.

stories.zh_summary: 英偉達執行長早前也退出了 Anthropic 活動。

stories.title: Goldman CEO Solomon says AI financing remains strong despite market jitters
stories.summary: Goldman CEO David Solomon says investor appetite for AI infrastructure remains strong despite a reset in AI stocks and political uncertainty around data centers.
stories.zh_title: 高盛執行長所羅門表示，儘管市場不安，人工智慧融資仍然強勁
stories.zh_summary: 高盛執行長大衛所羅門表示，儘管人工智慧股票重新調整以及圍繞數據中心的政治不確定性，投資者對人工智慧基礎設施的興趣仍然強勁。

stories.title: David Ellison says AI could be the ‘biggest creative unlock in modern history’
stories.summary: During Paramount Skydance's latest earnings call, CEO David Ellison said "it's hard to imagine" AI won't have a bigger impact on the film industry than CGI. stories.title: The race is on to sue Nvidia
stories.summary: Nvidia’s stock slid more than 4% after its board opened an investigation into Jensen Huang’s relationship with a suspected Chinese spy, and one securities law expert says the company’s earlier insistence that it was all “normal” could turn into a very expensive problem.
stories.zh_title: 起訴 Nvidia 的競賽已經開始
stories.zh_summary: 在董事會對黃仁勳與一名中國間諜嫌疑人的關係展開調查後，英偉達股價下跌超過 4%，一位證券法專家表示，該公司此前堅稱這一切都是「正常」的，這可能會變成一個代價高昂的問題。

stories.title: Dow sees its third 1,000-point swing in four days. Why the volatility isn’t over yet.
stories.summary: “It took one election and a poor Nvidia headline to go from D.C. being a tailwind to D.C. as a potential headwind,” says strategist.
stories.zh_title: 道瓊指數四天內第三次突破 1,000 點。為什麼波動還沒結束。
stories.zh_summary: 策略師表示：“經過一次選舉和英偉​​達糟糕的標題，華盛頓才從順風變成了潛在的逆風。”
